description: Search stations, pull live departure and arrival boards, plan journeys with real-time platforms and transfers, find nearby stops, check accessibility, or collect VBB/DB disruptions. No login, key or proxy needed.

address.description: Street address used as the reachable-from origin (mode=reachable). Coordinates are also required.
address.title: Address

arrivalTime.description: ISO 8601 arrival time for journeys (mode=journeys). Used only when `departureTime` is empty.
arrivalTime.title: Arrival time

bike.description: Only plan journeys that allow bicycle carriage (mode=journeys).
bike.title: Allow bicycles

departureTime.description: ISO 8601 date/time for journeys, or the board start time for departures/arrivals. Empty means now. Example: `2026-12-01T08:30:00+01:00`.
departureTime.title: Departure time

destinationId.description: Optional destination ID, DHID/IFOPT or 9-digit VBB ID (mode=journeys). Overrides `destination`.
destinationId.title: Destination station ID

direction.description: Only departures/arrivals heading to this station name or ID (modes=departures, arrivals).
direction.sectionDescription: Used by departure and arrival boards.
direction.title: Direction filter

disruptionSource.description: Which disruption feed to use (mode=disruptions). `all` combines every source.
disruptionSource.title: Disruption source

duration.description: How many minutes ahead the departure/arrival board should cover (modes=departures, arrivals, disruptions with source=vbb).
duration.title: Board window (minutes)

evaNumber.description: Optional Deutsche Bahn EVA number for a station-specific DB disruption query (mode=disruptions, source=db).
evaNumber.title: DB EVA number

includeElevatorHistory.description: Attach brokenlifts station-page outage history to elevator records (mode=disruptions, source=elevators/all).
includeElevatorHistory.title: Include elevator history

includeRemarks.description: Attach warning/status remarks to departures, arrivals and journeys (modes=departures, arrivals, journeys).
includeRemarks.title: Include disruption remarks

includeStopovers.description: Include intermediate stops inside each journey leg (mode=journeys). Adds detail and payload size.
includeStopovers.title: Include stopovers

language.description: Language of operational text such as departure directions and disruption captions.
language.title: Result language

latitude.description: Centre latitude for nearby search (mode=nearby). If omitted, `query` is resolved to coordinates first.
latitude.sectionDescription: Use explicit coordinates, or a station/place name in `query` when coordinates are empty.
latitude.title: Latitude

line.description: Optional line name such as `RE5`, `S5` or `ICE 606` for DB disruptions (mode=disruptions, source=db).
line.title: DB line filter

lookaheadDays.description: How many days ahead to include DB Verkehrslage alerts (mode=disruptions). 0 means today only.
lookaheadDays.title: Disruption look-ahead (days)

maxDuration.description: Maximum travel time from the address (mode=reachable).
maxDuration.title: Max reachable duration (minutes)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000).
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch. The legacy value `routes` is still accepted and runs the journeys mode.
mode.title: Mode

north.sectionDescription: Used by live vehicle radar and reachable-stop searches.
north.title: North latitude

origin.sectionDescription: Used by the journeys mode. Provide station names or explicit IDs; IDs win when both are set.
origin.title: Origin station

originId.description: Optional origin ID, DHID/IFOPT or 9-digit VBB ID (mode=journeys). Overrides `origin`.
originId.title: Origin station ID

query.description: Station, stop or place name. Used by stations, departures, arrivals and VBB/elevator disruptions. Also used as the centre for nearby when coordinates are not set.
query.title: Station search query

radius.description: Maximum distance from the centre for nearby stops (mode=nearby).
radius.title: Search radius (metres)

state.description: Optional state filter for DB Verkehrslage alerts (mode=disruptions, source=db or all).
state.title: German state

stationId.description: Optional VBB station ID, DHID/IFOPT (e.g. `900003201` or `de:11000:900003201`). Skips the name lookup for departures, arrivals, disruptions and stations.
stationId.title: Station ID

transfers.description: Maximum number of changes for journeys (mode=journeys). Leave empty to let the source decide.
transfers.title: Max transfers

transportModes.description: Only include these line modes. Empty means all modes. Applies to stations, departures, arrivals and journeys.
transportModes.title: Transport modes

walkingSpeed.description: Walking speed used for transfer walks (mode=journeys).
walkingSpeed.title: Walking speed

title: Berlin Transit Station, Route and Departure Scraper Input
